about.title: About the Project
about.subtitle: Rediscovering your musical history, one data point at a time.

mission.title: The Mission
mission.text:
Spotify Stats was born out of a simple need: curiosity. Streaming platforms collect a massive amount of data about us, but they rarely give us the tools to understand that data in depth.

This project aims to give that power back to the user. Whether it's to remember the soundtrack of a specific year, understand how your musical taste has shifted, or just fine-tune stats with surgical precision (like timezones and skip criteria), here you're in control.

wrapped.title: Beyond Wrapped
wrapped.text: Why wait for December? Analyze your listening habits from January to January, or filter by specific periods whenever you want.

control.title: Total Control
control.text: Define what counts as a 'stream'. Adjust minimum play time, timezones, and ignore accidental skips.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Full transparency on how your data is (and isn't) processed.

zero_upload.title: Zero-Upload Architecture
zero_upload.text: This project operates under a strict local processing (Client-Side) philosophy. When you select your Spotify JSON files, processing occurs exclusively in your browser's RAM, using technologies like Web Workers.
zero_upload.guarantee_text: Not a single byte of your files is sent to external servers, cloud, or databases. If you disconnect your internet after loading the page, the system will continue to work perfectly.

volatile_storage.title: Volatile Storage
volatile_storage.text:
We do not use tracking cookies or persistent databases for your files. The processing results exist only while the browser tab is open.

Upon refreshing the page or closing the browser, all imported data is instantly discarded from your device's memory.

auditability.title: Auditability (GPL v3)
auditability.text:
This software is free and open source, licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0.

This means our privacy promise isn't just based on trust, but on verification. Anyone with technical knowledge can audit the source code to confirm there are no hidden data collection mechanisms.

footer.no_affiliation: This project has no official affiliation with Spotify AB.
footer.data_usage: Data usage follows the terms of service of the user's own data export.

tutorial.title: How to Request Your Spotify Data
tutorial.subtitle: To generate accurate statistics, we need your full streaming history. The standard Spotify API doesn't provide this data, so you need to request it manually.

important_note.title: Crucial: Extended Streaming History
important_note.text: In step 3, you MUST select the option "Extended streaming history". The standard history only covers the last year and is not sufficient for a complete analysis.

step1.title: Go to Privacy Settings
step1.text: Use the button at the bottom of this page to navigate directly to your Spotify account's privacy section.

step2.title: Log In
step2.text: If you are not already logged in, enter your Spotify credentials to access the secure area.

step3.title: Request Your Data
step3.text: Scroll down to the "Download your data" section. Check the box for "Extended streaming history". This is essential. You may also check "Account data".

step4.title: Confirm via Email
step4.text: Spotify will send an email almost immediately to confirm the request. You must click the confirmation link inside this email to proceed.

step5.title: Wait for Your Data
step5.text: Spotify may take anywhere from a few days to a few weeks to process the extended history. You will receive a second email with a link to download a ZIP file once it is ready.
